text:
Lena: Hey all  quick thread for ramp checklist + who-to-ask for my first week as new manager. Trying to keep it lean.

Ben (HR): Welcome @Lena! Congrats. High-level: final offer paperwork should be completed by EOD, benefits orientation scheduled Day 2, and payroll setup done already. DM if anything missing.

Lena: Thanks! Two immediate asks: 1) laptop + peripherals ETA 2) access to monitoring dashboard 3) onboarding buddy?

Chris (IT): Laptop order placed. Tracking: 1ZABC12345. Standard bundle includes monitor + dock; add a second monitor in the IT form if preferred. Quick command for ticket: 
```
/it-order --user lena --bundle manager-pro
```

Kate (Security): For dashboards (prod metrics + traces) we need: security training completion + short justification for access. Training links: https://learning.redwood.io/sec/onboard and https://learning.redwood.io/sec/roles. Also sign the Data Access Agreement with /sig data-access.

Leo (Ops): I'll assign an onboarding buddy (should be someone on your immediate team) and block a 60m tour on Day 1 for runbooks + incident playbooks. Also sending our weekly oncall rotation overview.

Lena: Who approves API keys and service accounts?

Kate (Security): API keys = Product lead + Security sign-off. If you need service accounts for automation, include exact scopes and expiration policy in the request. Prototype: 'service-account: ci-deployer, scopes: storage.read, expires: 90d'.

Ben (HR): Week 1 suggested agenda (keep things focused):
- Day 0: HR paperwork, MDM enrollment, Duo MFA
- Day 1: Team intro + buddy shadow (60m), calendar of 1:1s
- Day 2: Infra & monitoring tour, create access requests for missing services
- Day 3: Meet PM & Product Ops, draft 30/60/90 goals with manager
- Day 4: Identify first process to improve + schedule stakeholder check-ins
Use the manager 30/60/90 template: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/mgr-30-60-90 (tip: put metrics next to each goal).

onboarding-bot: Created folder: /onboarding/lena_manager_welcome and copied templates. :tada:

Chris (IT): If you prefer expedited shipping, reply here and I'll mark priority. Also add home address and phone to the order form.

Lena: Will do. One more: how do we quantify "ship one small process improvement" for the 30d goal?

Leo (Ops): Example measures: reduce mean time to restore for a specific incident class by 10%, or cut a manual weekly sync from 60m to async updates with a 50% decrease in meeting time. Put a clear owner + due date.

Kate (Security): Add a note  for any privileged automation (CI/CD tokens, deployer accounts) we require a rotation schedule and alerting to detect unused keys after 30 days.

Lena: Filing IT order and starting trainings. I'll post updates here once laptop arrives and 1:1s are scheduled. Thanks everyone!

Ben (HR): We'll schedule a 30/60/90 calibration with you and your manager at the end of week 4 to align expectations. Ping if anything blocks ramp. :calendar:
